molly: quick pitch  'Spark Sessions'  3 short codelabs, one tiny refapp, live mentor hour. deliverables: launch post, 3 labs, refapp repo, gated webinar funnel, and inbound routing. short plan below.

ryan: love it. can we reuse the tiny-refapp template and include a Docker quickstart? saves time.

kate: i'll write the labs (each ~20m): setup, perf tuning, deploy. drafts by Fri COB.

omar: i'll scaffold the repo (MIT) w/ README + run-local.sh. ETA Mon. will add CONTRIBUTING.md for mentors.

jen: i'll own landing + email drip (confirm, 24h reminder, follow-up with repo + replay). will add UTMs and HubSpot tags `spark_interest`.

molly: routing rule: tag leads `spark_interest`; if they attend + complete labs -> route to SE. also add Slack CTA to #spark-sessions.

ryan: metrics to track: landing visits, signups, attendance, lab completions, repo stars, MQLs. set dashboards in Amplitude + HubSpot.

``
